```{r}
#| message: false

# install.packages(tidyverse)

# install.packages("readr")

library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(tinytable)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
# Reading in raw data, skipping 8 lines of title and notes, and ignoring
# footnotes below the 13 rows of data

raw_data <- read_csv(
  "Commute_Data.csv",
  skip = 8,
  n_max = 13,
  col_names = FALSE,
  col_types = cols(.default = col_character())
  )

raw_data


```

```{r}
# Slicing out header rows and dropping the first column (row labels)

headers <- raw_data |>
  slice(1:6) |>
  select(-1) |>
  as.matrix()
```


```{r}
# Creating labels for every column

col_labels <- tibble(
  col = seq_len(ncol(headers)), 
  geography = headers[1, ], 
  age = headers[3, ], 
  gender = headers[4, ], 
  duration = headers[6, ]
) |> 
  fill(geography, age, gender)

col_labels
```

```{r}
# Creating rows for each number (stacking long data) & ensuring that columns
# align with the numbers from the previous chunk 

long_data <- raw_data |> 
  slice(8:13) |> 
  rename(mode = X1) |> 
  pivot_longer(-mode, names_to = "col", values_to = "value") |>
  mutate(col = parse_number(col) - 1)

long_data

unique(long_data$mode)
```

```{r}
# Joining data with labels 

long_data_w_columns <- long_data |> 
  left_join(col_labels, by = "col")

long_data_w_columns

unique(long_data_w_columns$mode)
```

```{r}
# Cleaning text to remove unnecessary numbers and characters 

cleaned_long_data <- long_data_w_columns |> 
  mutate(
    mode = str_remove(mode, "\\s+\\d+$"), 
    geography = str_remove(geography, "\\s+i\\d+$"), 
    gender = str_remove(gender, "\\s+\\d+$"), 
    count = parse_number(value)
  )

cleaned_long_data

unique(cleaned_long_data$mode)
```

```{r}
# Filtering table to keep only "Car, truck or van", Public transit", 
# "Active transportation", and "Other method" (the two "driver" and 
# "passenger" modes would overlap with "Car, truck or van" and would therefore
# double-count people)

modes_keep <- c("Car, truck or van", "Public transit", "Active transportation", 
                "Other method")

final_cleaned_commute <- cleaned_long_data |> 
  filter(
    age == "Total - Age", 
    duration == "Total - Commuting duration", 
    mode %in% modes_keep
  ) |>
  select(geography, gender, mode, count)

final_cleaned_commute

unique(final_cleaned_commute$mode)
```
